name: qevra-desktop
description: QEVRA - Local-First Context-Aware AI Voice-to-Action Platform
author: QEVRA Team

scripts.build: electron-vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); if(fs.existsSync('src/main/detect-window.exe')) fs.copyFileSync('src/main/detect-window.exe', 'out/main/detect-window.exe'); if(fs.existsSync('src/main/send-input.exe')) fs.copyFileSync('src/main/send-input.exe', 'out/main/send-input.exe'); const binDir='out/bin'; if(!fs.existsSync(binDir)) fs.mkdirSync(binDir, {recursive:true}); const wks='node_modules/node-global-key-listener/bin/WinKeyServer.exe'; if(fs.existsSync(wks)) fs.copyFileSync(wks, 'out/bin/WinKeyServer.exe');"
